title: Traya Health - Lead Data Engineer - Python/SQL
description:
**Lead Data Us**
Traya is an Indian direct-to-consumer hair care brand platform providing a holistic treatment for consumers dealing with hair loss. The Company provides personalized consultations that help determine the root cause of hair fall among individuals, along with a range of hair care products that are curated from a combination of Ayurveda, Allopathy, and Nutrition. Traya's secret lies in the power of diagnosis. Our unique platform diagnoses the patient's hair and health history, to identify the root cause behind hair fall and delivers customized hair kits to them right at their doorstep. We have a strong adherence system in place via medically trained hair coaches and proprietary tech, where we guide the customer across their hair growth journey, and help them stay on track.
  
  
**Our Vision**
Traya was created with a global vision to create awareness around hair loss, de-stigmatise it while empathizing with the customers that it has an emotional and psychological impact. Most importantly, to combine 3 different sciences (Ayurveda, Allopathy and Nutrition) to create the perfect holistic solution for hair loss patients.
  
  
**The Founders**
Founded by Saloni Anand, a techie-turned-marketeer and Altaf Saiyed, a Stanford Business School alumnus.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're building our data platform from the ground up and are looking for a Data Engineer who enjoys designing clean, scalable solutions from scratch. You'll work on everything from ingestion and transformation to storage and orchestration - ensuring we have reliable, secure, high-quality data to power analytics, reporting, and machine learning. We're open to the tech stack and value engineers who can choose the right tools for the job, though experience with modern cloud data ecosystems and big data frameworks will be a plus.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines for both batch and streaming workloads.
* Develop ETL/ELT processes to bring data from multiple systems into a data lake or warehouse.
* Implement scalable storage and querying solutions (e.g., S3 or similar, Trino/Presto, Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Build big data processing jobs using frameworks like Spark, Flink, or equivalents.
* Write clean, maintainable code in Python, Scala, or Java for data processing and automation.
* Set up workflow orchestration with tools like Apache Airflow or similar.
* Work with streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis or any similar) and Change Data Capture tools (Debezium or similar).
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipelines for reliability and performance.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are in place.
* Collaborate closely with analysts, data scientists, and backend engineers to deliver trusted datasets.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related fields.
* Strong SQL skills with experience in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Hands-on experience with distributed processing frameworks (Spark, Flink, etc.).
* Proficiency in Python and/or Scala/Java.
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow or equivalents).
* Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis) and CDC tools (Debezium or similar).
* Knowledge of data modeling, schema design, and performance tuning.

**Nice To Have**

* Exposure to NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, etc.).
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Understanding of lakehouse and data versioning technologies (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg).
* CI/CD practices for data pipelines.

**Why You'll Enjoy Working Here**

* You'll be part of building the data platform from scratch.
* Freedom to influence and choose the right technologies for the job.
* Collaborative, engineering-first culture solving real, high-volume data challenges.

description:

**What’s Exciting About The Role**
Verifone is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. Rather than being a single-technology specialist position, this is a unique opportunity to your generalist skillset to own and evolve a broad data platform that spans streaming pipelines, multiple database technologies, on prem and cloud infrastructure, and DevOps/SRE operational tooling.
  
  
We are looking for experience in core technologies including Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering, with the opportunity to leverage other skills such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server and more. You will design and operate end-to-end data pipelines that power new AI and analytics initiatives, migrate streaming services to Kubernetes, and build the automation and tooling that reduces operational toil across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Platform & Pipeline Development**

* Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines—streaming and batch—that serve Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics initiatives.
* Work with diverse data technologies and formats: streaming via Kafka, batch via ETL processes, file formats such as Parquet, and table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake.
* Collaborate with data engineering and development teams to enforce best practices for data flow, schema design, security, scalability, and performance.
* Continuously improve data pipeline reliability, latency, and throughput across the full SDLC.
* Support and integrate AWS data tooling including Athena, Glue, Redshift, and S3-based data lake patterns.

**Streaming Infrastructure (Kafka & Ecosystem)**

* Manage and support Apache Kafka clusters (including AWS MSK), Kafka Connect, and KSQL for high-throughput, fault-tolerant event streaming.
* Handle day-to-day Kafka operations: offset management, lag monitoring, consumer group management, cluster rebalancing, and partition tuning.
* Perform cluster maintenance: upgrades, configuration changes, scaling events, and health checks.
* Drive incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for streaming platform issues.
* Participate in the active effort to migrate Kafka and related services to Kubernetes.

**Database Operations**

* Operate and support multiple database technologies in production: Redis, PostgreSQL and MySQL (indexing, replication, HA/DR, query tuning), and MongoDB.
* Perform routine maintenance across database platforms: upgrades, configuration tuning, health monitoring, and capacity planning.
* Support Snowflake data warehouse operations and integrations as part of the broader analytics stack.
* Implement and uphold data security practices including encryption-in-transit/at-rest, secrets management, and least-privilege access across all data stores.

**DevOps, SRE & Automation**

* Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, Bash) to reduce manual toil and improve platform reliability.
* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines for patching, deployment, and configuration automation.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Containerize and orchestrate workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS: EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and related services.
* Set up and maintain observability tooling—metrics, logs, and tracing—and participate in on-call incident response.
* Support cloud migration tasks, moving workloads between on-prem and cloud environments.

We are looking for a well-rounded platform engineer with experience in Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering. Candidates should demonstrate breadth across data, databases, DevOps and SRE skills:
  
  

* 5+ years of overall engineering experience, with demonstrated work across data pipelines, database operations, and infrastructure—not limited to a single technology.
* Hands-on experience with Kafka or another distributed streaming platform (Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar) in a production environment.
* Operational experience with at least two of the following database technologies: Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redshift or Snowflake.
* Proven data pipeline experience: building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, batch jobs, or streaming pipelines that serve analytics or operational use cases.
* Strong scripting and automation skills (Python and/or Bash) with a track record of reducing manual toil.
* CI/CD pipeline development and Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform preferred).
* Solid Linux fundamentals: networking basics, log analysis, system troubleshooting, process/memory/disk management.
* Cloud engineering experience, preferably AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK/ElastiCache, CloudWatch).
* Familiarity with observability practices—metrics, logs, tracing—and incident response workflows.
* Understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: availability, consistency, partitions, backpressure.
* Strong communication skills including the ability to present platform status and technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
* Flexibility for on-call rotation and occasional weekend support.

**Preferred Skills (Highly Desired)**
**Data Engineering Depth**

* Experience with stream processing frameworks: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, or similar.
* Familiarity with data lake table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
* Hands-on experience with AWS data services: Athena, Glue, Redshift, or Lake Formation.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake—data loading, query optimization, or integration patterns.
* Understanding of data quality, data lineage, or schema registry concepts.

**Infrastructure & Security**

* Container/Kubernetes depth: deployments, StatefulSets, storage classes, Helm.
* On-prem infrastructure experience: VMware/KVM, SAN/NAS storage, network configuration.
* Security and compliance experience, particularly PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard).
* Secrets management tooling: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar.

**What We Offer**

* Broad platform ownership—you will work across Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, and more, growing as a well-rounded platform engineer rather than a single-tool specialist.
* Direct impact on Verifone’s global payment infrastructure—your work keeps billions of transactions flowing reliably every year.
* Ground-floor involvement in building the data pipelines that will drive Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics strategy.
* Hands-on participation in a Kafka-to-Kubernetes migration—a meaningful infrastructure modernization project from day one.
* Mentorship from senior engineers and platform architects with deep production experience.
* Clear career progression path from mid-level to senior and lead engineer.
* Funded certification paths—Confluent (CCDAK, Certified Administrator), AWS (Solutions Architect, MSK Specialty), CKA, dbt—plus budget for courses and technical conferences.
* Hybrid/remote working flexibility with a collaborative team culture.
* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. *The Pod Model*
*Enterprise AE*
— owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.
  
  
*Forward Deployed Engineer*
— owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
  
  
We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Designated Support Engineer III to join our team in a hybrid capacity based in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, Global Focal Support within our Support department. You will function as the highest level of technical support within the TAC, responsible for resolving the most complex and critical issues escalated from Level I and Level II support engineers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Provide second line phone/email consultation to independently debug complex security/network problems
* Interface with Engineering and assist the customer with testing or troubleshooting
* Reproduce customer issues to verify problems and provide feedback to Engineering and Operations teams
* Create entries in our technical support online database to accurately document any incident resolution that is not found in our knowledge base
* Understand the product direction and customer use-cases and provide input on product and code changes through all points of the product cycle

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.
* You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
* 5+ years of support and networking experience, including general firewalls and packet filtering troubleshooting
* Proficient in using Wireshark, Fiddler, MTR, and traceroute to analyze network and application protocols, isolate faults, diagnose packet loss, and resolve unexpected session resets.
* Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting GRE and IPSec VPN tunnels, combined with leveraging PAC files to optimize network pathing and traffic flow
* Deep expertise in enterprise authentication (SAML, Kerberos), application-layer mechanics (HTTP methods), IPv4/IPv6 routing, and DNS administration

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Demonstrate a proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
* Prior knowledge of Forward Proxy and cloud environments like AWS and Azure
* Direct experience working in Firewall and VPN/Zero Trust environments
